title: The W3 Total Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and…
description: The W3 Total Cache plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 2.11.0 has a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to expose sensitive information. Specifically, attackers can extract the live password-reset key (rp_key) from cached reset forms by exploiting the 'utm_source' parameter and the victim's active wp-resetpass cookie. This vulnerability requires certain cache configurations and user interaction with a crafted URL, potentially enabling full administrator account takeover.
